title: Mission: The Compass
activityInstruction: Use the compass rose to find north, east, south, and west.

storyQuestions.prompt: How many little pirates are there?

storyQuestions.success: Captain Jenny found a treasure map.
There was a big X on the map.

storyQuestions.prompt: What are the pirates looking for?
storyQuestions.success: The pirates are looking for treasure.

storyQuestions.prompt: What did the map say first?
storyQuestions.success: The map said to go north first.
They should take ten steps north.
They should go past the big rock.

storyQuestions.prompt: Did the pirates know where north was?
storyQuestions.success: No, the pirates did not know where north was.

quiz.prompt: Which way does a compass needle point?

parts.label: Housing
parts.fact: The housing protects the parts inside the compass.

parts.label: Ring
parts.fact: The ring lets you hold or carry the compass.

parts.label: Direction dial
parts.fact: The direction dial shows north, east, south, and west.
parts.help: The round face with direction marks.

parts.label: Needle
parts.fact: The needle points north to help you find your way.
parts.help: The thin pointer in the middle.
